release: ENG466 PR2-9 public test package v1
known_limitations: Guest soft failures continue, but a host assertion, process termination, or Vulkan device loss cannot be recovered inside the XISO.
The PR2-9 binary predates ENG-465. Known affected Vulkan drivers may lose the device on bordered BC2 fallback routes; use OpenGL full-suite execution or isolate S3TC masks.
scope_note: These binaries are exact PR2-9 publication builds. The later 141-record A/B candidate also contained Forgejo pull #10 and ENG-465; its performance numbers must not be attributed to this narrower package.
